claire (product_designer): quick follow-up from today's design review 1: a small set of compliance UI nits to finish before we flip the feature flag. i'll list copy + a11y + tiny layout asks.

raj (frontend): good call. paste the current audit sample so i can grep it.

claire (product_designer): current: `User updated retention to 90` 1: problems: no units, no actor/method placement. propose table-friendly: `Retention: 30d 1 90d 1 rebecca (UI)` and human-friendly detail: `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days by rebecca (UI)`.

olga (docs): prefer the sentence form for logs and docs: `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days by rebecca (UI)` 1: searchable and consistent.

tanya (security): backend will store structured fields (actor, method, resource_id, severity). UI must surface actor+method. also mark destructive actions (retention shrink, enable BYOK) as `warning` severity.

leo (a11y): accessibility nit 1: retention dropdown currently shows `30 60 90` without units. screen readers read numbers only. change visible options to `30 days`, `60 days`, `90 days`. compact table can show `30d` but each item must have `aria-label=\"30 days\"`. Also add `aria-label='Data retention period'` on the select.

raj (frontend): easy change. i'll add i18n keys: `retention.expanded.30 = \"30 days\"` and `retention.compact.30 = \"30d\"`. will wire `aria-label` to expanded key.

claire (product_designer): KMS/encryption badge confusion: current badge reads `KMS`. suggestion: table pill `Encrypted (Platform)` vs `Encrypted (BYOK)`; detail view: `Platform-managed key` / `Customer-managed key (Bring Your Own Key)` with link `Learn about key ownership`.

tanya (security): agree. BYOK enable flow must include modal with a clear warning and required checkbox: `I understand BYOK responsibilities and that losing the key may render data unrecoverable`. log `BYOKEnabled` audit event with actor and workspace id.

leo (a11y): pill contrast must meet 4.5:1. current BYOK blue fails. use darker background or white text. pill icon should be `aria-hidden=true` and expose readable text `Encryption type: Customer-managed key` via a screen-reader-only label.

raj (frontend): will update pill styles and add focus state. table uses compact `Encrypted (Platform)` / `Encrypted (BYOK)`. detail uses expanded.

claire (product_designer): region default affordance: product wants org-level default. security wants discoverable control. engineering wants minimal clutter. proposed compromise: inline toggle `Make this the default region for new resources (Org admins only)` with a `?` tooltip linking to org defaults.

tanya (security): visible toggle is fine. require org admin to change. tooltip should say `Changes affect only new resources; existing resources unchanged.`

leo (a11y): tooltip trigger must be keyboard focusable and tooltip should have `role=\"tooltip\"` and `aria-describedby` linking to the helper text. avoid color-only cues.

olga (docs): tooltip copy suggestion: `Make this the org default for newly created dedicated deployments. Org admins only.` I'll add it to docs.

claire (product_designer): audit CSV export: customers want structured columns for easier analysis. propose: `event_type, field_changed, old_value, new_value, actor, method, resource_id, severity, timestamp, meta_json` where `meta_json` is optional.

tanya (security): exports must be gated to `org_admin` and `compliance_officer`. meta_json must be reviewed for PII redaction. add audit event `AuditExportDownloaded` recording user and filters.

mike (ops): small ops ask: changing org default region shouldn't trigger any data movement. please make tooltip explicit: `No migration of existing resources` so customers don't worry.

raj (frontend): on export CSV, we'll include `meta_json` as a quoted string column. mike, we'll gate downloads to admins via API check.

claire (product_designer): retention confirmation modal wording: current `Are you sure?` too vague. new primary: `Change retention to 90 days for Workspace X?` secondary: `Messages older than 90 days may be permanently deleted. Review data lifecycle docs.` For destructive changes require checkbox `I understand this may permanently delete messages older than the new retention period`.

tanya (security): enforce checkbox for shrink actions and log `RetentionReducedConfirmed`. good to require explicit consent.

leo (a11y): ensure modal focus trap and that checkbox + CTA accessible via keyboard. avoid `learn more` as lone link text; prefer `Learn about data lifecycle`.

raj (frontend): will implement modal with disabled primary until checkbox checked, add analytics events: `retention_change_requested` and `retention_change_confirmed` with old/new values. will open a PR today.

olga (docs): i'll update docs and include sample audit CSV row examples and modal copy.

ship-bot: scheduled staging deploy for `compliance-panel/v2` on 2026-04-20T03:30:00Z :rocket:

claire (product_designer): action items: raj PR for i18n + pills + modal, tanya review BYOK modal & export redaction, leo a11y QA, olga update docs. i'll upload updated artboards in this thread when ready. thanks all :seedling:
